description: Accepts the human's current revision as nonbinding terms. Pass the revision number you read. Nonbinding: never a contract, charge, assignment or dispatch.

account_token.description: Account token, if your account claimed that conversation. Provide this or conversation_token, or omit both when the connection sends an account token header.

conversation_token.description: Token of the conversation the request belongs to. Provide this or account_token.

anyOf.description: Optional note shown with this revision. Max 2000 characters.

revision.description: The revision you accept. Must be the current one, so nobody accepts terms they have not seen.

name: accept_nonbinding_proposal
title: Accept proposal terms (nonbinding)
